rows.label: bf05410100_0010
rows.name: How awful...

rows.label: bf05410100_0020
rows.name:
Looks like they didn't even
get a chance to resist.

rows.label: bf05410100_0030
rows.name: There! It's coming!

rows.label: bf05410100_0040
rows.name: Watch out! Dodge!

rows.label: bf05410100_0050
rows.name: [ML:undisp ]うわぁっ

rows.label: bf05410100_0060
rows.name: Is everyone safe?

rows.label: bf05410100_0070
rows.name: Yeah, somehow.

rows.label: bf05410100_0080
rows.name: We have to stop it!

rows.label: bf05410100_0090
rows.name: But how?

rows.label: bf05410100_0110
rows.name:
There's a Superbia-made
auxiliary drive on its back.

rows.label: bf05410100_0120
rows.name:
If we can somehow sever the cables
connecting it to each leg,

rows.label: bf05410100_0130
rows.name:
its energy supply will
be cut off. It'll stop.

rows.label: bf05410100_0140
rows.name:
Can't we destroy it with
Hikari-sama's power?

rows.label: bf05410100_0150
rows.name: That's it!

rows.label: bf05410100_0160
rows.name: Certainly. Destroying it would be possible.

rows.label: bf05410100_0170
rows.name:
That is, if we don't mind reducing
the whole area to ashes.

rows.label: bf05410100_0180
rows.name: What do you mean?

rows.label: bf05410100_0190
rows.name:
According to a report I read before,
that weapon's main armament...

rows.label: bf05410100_0200
rows.name:
apparently uses vaporized bodily fluids
from a Divine Beast.

rows.label: bf05410100_0210
rows.name:
The vaporized fluid is highly unstable.
Even a slight impact or heat can cause a huge blast.

rows.label: bf05410100_0220
rows.name:
In fact, a large-scale explosion accident
occurred here three months ago.

rows.label: bf05410100_0230
rows.name:
If we'd fired without knowing that,
it could've been a disaster.

rows.label: bf05410100_0240
rows.name: Damn it...

rows.label: bf05410100_0250
rows.name: Why make a weapon that dangerous?

rows.label: bf05410100_0260
rows.name:
Even if it gets destroyed in enemy territory,
it can annihilate the enemy along with it.

rows.label: bf05410100_0270
rows.name: That's the design philosophy, it seems.

rows.label: bf05410100_0280
rows.name:
I question the sanity of
whoever thought of this.

rows.label: bf05410100_0290
rows.name:
That's exactly why His Majesty
ordered it stopped.

rows.label: bf05410100_0300
rows.name: Can't we drag out whoever's inside?

rows.label: bf05410100_0310
rows.name:
The control chamber is protected
by 10 layers of reinforced armor.

rows.label: bf05410100_0320
rows.name:
It's difficult to enter or
destroy it from the outside.

rows.label: bf05410100_0330
rows.name:
However, not all of the drive and
cables are covered by armor.

rows.label: bf05410100_0340
rows.name: So if we do it, that's the only place.

rows.label: bf05410100_0350
rows.name: How do we jump onto its back, mo?

rows.label: bf05410100_0360
rows.name:
A little further ahead, there's a
place where the cliff juts out.

rows.label: bf05410100_0370
rows.name:
From there, I think we
can jump onto its back.

rows.label: bf05410100_0380
rows.name:
But if our timing's off, we'll plunge
straight down the cliff, you know?

rows.label: bf05410100_0390
rows.name:
And doing that while evading its attacks
would be extremely difficult.

rows.label: bf05410100_0400
rows.name: I'll take care of it.

rows.label: bf05410100_0410
rows.name: Fan-san?

rows.label: bf05410100_0420
rows.name:
I'll stop the Divine Beast with my power.
While it's stopped, all of you get on its back.

rows.label: bf05410100_0430
rows.name: Fan-san, you...

rows.label: bf05410100_0440
rows.name:
All right, then! But
you'd better be careful!

rows.label: bf05410100_0450
rows.name: Yes, I understand.

rows.label: bf05410100_0460
rows.name: Alright, let's hurry.
